description: Apache HTTP Server can serve static web pages and assets. Learn virtual hosts, directory access, content types, modules and error pages through simple configuration examples. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
